scope: G09 J-F5/P0 finite source cost ledger only; no new capabilities/shapes or reopening of closed leaf modules.

symbols.J: projected pipeline jobs including conversion/repack stages
symbols.ports: sum of actual fragment input/output ports
symbols.B: observed native backing views before dedup

ledger.cost: JointPipelinePlan append/CSR prepare is amortized O(J+E) including duplicate projected edges; per-slot frontier prepare/reset is O(J+E) for the prepared graph. Plan stores jobs, forward dependencies, successor offsets, reverse successor edges. This is NOT the complete compiler or complete run cost.
ledger.allocator: All these vectors use the original supplied mem::StdAllocator. Construction/resizing may allocate cold and capacity slack is real.

ledger.cost: Beyond CSR, projection scans V values/I inputs/F fragments and their input/output ports and original dependency lists. Temporary host_ready/native_ready arrays are O(V), fragment index array O(F), dependency scratch O(max fragment degree); the shared immutable Plan retains pipeline+stages. Amortized O(V+I+F+ports+D+J+E) for this projection, not for native compilation/fusion/alias analysis.

CUDA has no separate graph_route_cpu_cuda/plan.h; it borrows common PlanState and original Invocation. Each joint SLOT copies the common S segments and E dependencies into its own JointPipelinePlan, then CSR-prepares it O(S+E), plus frontier only when parallel. Unlike Apple/Vulkan shared Plan projection, this immutable identity copy is repeated per CUDA slot. Original common workspace/provider preparations remain additional costs.
ledger.allocator: CUDA uses ResourceBudget metadata_allocator when the common invocation storage exposes a shared budget (:621-624), otherwise caller allocator; RunState, InvocationState and original ResultSlot are allocated cold.

ledger.cost: Charge sizeof RunState+InvocationState+ResultSlot, vectors at ACTUAL capacities, original sub-invocations/results/arguments/pages/lease pools, and backing/workspace separately. CUDA also has O(I) WeightUse/weight-prefix cells and a per-slot O(S+E) pipeline. Native routes have O(V) ValueRun, O(F) FragmentRun, J-byte initially_complete and J size_t pending slots; conditional frontier has two J size_t arrays. Native FragmentRun retains original pending OwnedResult; Vulkan ValueRun additionally retains transfer Completion/TransferSlot. These owners are not extra tensor copies.
ledger.payload_formula: Pipeline capacity bytes = cap_jobs*sizeof(Job)+(cap_dependencies+cap_successor_begin+cap_successors)*sizeof(size_t). Frontier capacity bytes=(cap_remaining+cap_next)*sizeof(size_t), plus object/queue heads/tails. Use actual sizeof/capacity; no unmeasured ABI byte total or logical-size==allocated-size claim.

ledger.cost: Native Plan/Run metadata follows selected allocator, switched to shared ResourceBudget metadata allocator when provided. LeaseSubmission is pre-sized with prefixes=2I+F+sum(fragment output ports), page reads=2*sum(max_page_refs). The std::vector native arguments carrier is reserved cold but uses its original std allocator, not the custom StdAllocator. Provider-private and Scheduler allocations are not magically in this metadata budget.

prepare_replay is separate from submit: scans bindings/fragments/ports, validates exact carriers and descriptors, prepares original CPU/native/page/transfer state, counts planned copies/waits, may allocate a first/replacement backing, reserves actual completion capacity. CUDA requests S+2I+4 completion capacity and prepares original Graph. Native rebuilds J-bit binding-ready facts, parallel_after scans J+E, and when parallel frontier.prepare resets J+E; submit later resets again. Repeated unchanged capacity can reuse allocations, but binding changes, page updates, shape-dependent preparation and delegated costs are not universally allocation-free.

FIFO take O(1); successful complete visits that job successors once, summing O(J+E) across successful job completions, under short admission/publication monitors. Math, copies, native observations and CPU execution occur outside the total monitor. This bound excludes repeated pending observation and provider work.

Before admitting EACH next ready native job, the driver re-observes every currently pending native job. If N ready native jobs all remain pending, merely admitting them can cause N(N-1)/2 repeated pending observations, plus each initial observation. Subsequent observation count grows with actual latency and wakeups, with 1ms fiber backoff only when no immediately ready job/progress remains. Metadata is bounded by J; total polling is NOT bounded by E and need not be linear in J.
ledger.verdict: Explicit material P0 structure, not an automatic new product defect or permission to alter implementation/P1 shapes. Actual P1 and selected consumers determine remaining qualification.

ledger.cost: Each submit_segment retry re-scans dependencies from its beginning before Queue admission; cumulative dependency inspection includes sum_s(retries_s*indegree_s), not merely E. CPU child may also immediately poll the returned pending Completion and then wait1ms; root native lane retries at mailbox/timed wakeups. Device waits, host waits and synchronous CPU/native provider episodes preserve original costs.

Original per-step invocations/input-output spans/segment Completion/dependency scratch are pre-sized. submit_segment uses its unique segment slice and local Outcome; coordinator commits and finishes. Shared QueueSequence begin/enqueue dependency waits/enqueue steps/finish and delegated region submit remain real calls. Final aggregation scans actual candidates/accepted segment cells, merges ordered Queue prefixes and retains exact delegated work according to the original common plan. No provider math is hidden inside a new global lock; aggregation is not zero work or a universal O(1) operation.

Per active invocation, one existing Sched root and at most one extra coarse CPU child (kFiberStackLarge); no fiber per node/segment and no new thread pool. Two simultaneous slots may therefore use up to four such drivers, plus original native runtime workers. Fully ordered plans/binding-ready graphs use original inline root path without extra child. Serial fastpath does NOT remove all cold J metadata. spawn/stack-cache miss/parking/wakeup/refcounts and original Scheduler allocation costs remain real and are not covered by a claim of fixed frontier vectors.

CPU output bridge copies occur if the original CPU owner did not produce into fixed host backing; repack is an actual CPU invocation. Apple uploads/downloads keep original synchronous MemoryResource operations and checked host completion; only native math observation is advanced nonblocking. Vulkan retains original transfer handles and observes/reads successful downloads; records independent-transfer vs compute-queue upload eligibility. CUDA keeps original host/device/staging copy steps and weight wait prefixes. Exact ready bindings can skip input jobs, not producer math/dependency edges. UMA does not establish zero memcpy, zero coherence/retention cost, or physical bytes moved.

Cancellation shares admission claim lock; stops unclaimed work, never preempts accepted math. CPU child returns its ref under monitor before stopped/notify; root joins before final publication. Apple/Vulkan retain and wait all still-valid original native/transfer handles outside lock before clear and Lease body finish. CUDA collects accepted child Outcome, finishes original aggregate and every weight prefix before terminal. Cancellation/close latency includes actual slowest accepted work/provider/driver drain; it is not a fixed-time or constant-cost operation.

ReplayReport snapshots planned fragment/copy/repack/weight/native-completion and page-metadata costs, NOT actual poll iterations, kernel counts, timestamps, overlap, actual wait latency, or global allocations. ResourceReport covers requested shared-budget scope (including other invocations/old leases) plus deduplicated observed native backing, with unknown flags preserved. CUDA report requires shared budget; boundary_view_bytes may already be charged and must not be blindly added. Native managed fields remain partial without budget; default zero report fields do not prove private bytes zero.

Resource observation is a cold/idle operation: can allocate temporary metadata, query actual resource owners, sort/deduplicate backing/range views. Native O(V+B log B) backing enumeration plus budget resource scan; CUDA also scans constant ownership while collecting external ranges and sorts/merges ranges. It is not part of an allocation-free warm-submit promise. Driver queues/events/command buffers, MLX/provider compiler caches and temporary internals, runtime worker storage, external allocators, actual UMA residency/page migration and physical traffic remain UNKNOWN or excluded unless separately evidenced. No scope-wide memory/performance total follows from these snapshots.

explicit_nonclaims: No claim that complete compilation or complete execution is O(V+E)/O(E). Only the stated frontier/projection portions have those bounds.
No zero-allocation guarantee for prepare_replay, spawn/waits, native/delegated runtime, cancellation or ResourceReport; fixed G09 vector capacities are only one component.
No walltime bound, universal overlap, all-private-memory cap, UMA zero-copy assertion, P1 verdict, sanitizer result, SDK result or overall G09 closure is signed by source inspection.

Native N(N-1)/2 repeated observations and CUDA sum(retries*indegree) are recorded as actual cost mechanisms; this review does not authorize changing the product, benchmark shapes or statistical contract.
audit_actions: Only read source and git baseline blobs, inspect existing public report contracts, and write this requested ignored JSON. No builds/tests/performance/GPU work, product edits, new tools/frameworks or agents.
